meta.stack: React + TypeScript + Vite + Tiptap/ProseMirror + Yjs + SignalR Client + Zustand + Tailwind + shadcn/ui

priorityMeaning.P0: MVP blocker - nothing usable without it

conventions.dependsOn: Task IDs inside this file that must be 'done' before this task starts
conventions.dependsOnServer: Task IDs in tasks.server.json this task consumes; mock the contract to start earlier, but do not close the task until the server task is done
conventions.mvp: true = included in PRD section 52 MVP definition

phases.name: Foundation & Tooling
phases.goal: Vite app, design system, routing, API client, test harness

phases.name: Authentication UI
phases.goal: Register, login, token lifecycle, guarded routes, profile

phases.name: Dashboard & Document Management
phases.goal: Document list, search, sort and lifecycle actions

phases.name: Rich Text Editor
phases.goal: Tiptap editor with full formatting, toolbar and autosave UX

phases.name: Real-Time Collaboration
phases.goal: Yjs binding, SignalR provider, cursors, presence

phases.name: Offline & Resilience
phases.goal: Local persistence, reconnection, queued updates, merge

phases.name: Sharing & Permissions UI
phases.goal: Share dialog, invitations, roles, permission-aware UI

phases.name: Document Locking UI
phases.goal: Soft and hard lock indicators and controls

phases.name: AI Assistant UI
phases.goal: AI menu, preview, accept/reject into the Yjs document

phases.name: Notifications & Polish
phases.goal: Notification center, shortcuts, a11y, responsiveness, performance

phases.name: Release Engineering
phases.goal: Manual multi-user verification, build, Docker, CI

milestones.name: App shell with auth
milestones.exitCriteria: User can register, log in, stay logged in across refresh, and reach a protected route

milestones.name: Dashboard usable
milestones.exitCriteria: User can create, open, rename, duplicate, archive, delete and search documents

milestones.name: Editor usable solo
milestones.exitCriteria: Full formatting works and edits persist with a visible save state

milestones.name: Real-time collaboration live
milestones.exitCriteria: Two browsers edit one document with live cursors and presence

milestones.name: Offline-capable
milestones.exitCriteria: Editing continues offline and merges cleanly on reconnect

milestones.name: MVP frontend complete
milestones.exitCriteria: Comments, sharing, versions and AI write/rewrite all working end to end

milestones.name: Shippable
milestones.exitCriteria: Multi-user manual matrix passes; production build containerized

tasks.title: Scaffold Vite + React + TypeScript application
tasks.description: Create the Vite React-TS app with strict TypeScript, path aliases and the folder structure from PRD section 49 (app, components, pages, hooks, services, store, types, utils).
acceptanceCriteria: npm run dev serves the app with hot reload
strict and noUncheckedIndexedAccess are enabled and the build is clean
Folder structure matches PRD section 49

tasks.title: Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui setup
tasks.description: Install and configure Tailwind, initialise shadcn/ui, define the theme tokens (colors, spacing, radii, typography) and add the base component set used across the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Button, Input, Dialog, DropdownMenu, Avatar, Toast and Tooltip render correctly
Light and dark themes both work from a single token set
No unstyled flash on first paint

tasks.title: Linting, formatting and pre-commit hooks
tasks.description: ESLint with React/TypeScript/hooks rules, Prettier, import ordering and a pre-commit hook running lint and typecheck on staged files.
acceptanceCriteria: Commits with type errors or lint errors are blocked locally
Formatting is deterministic across machines

tasks.title: Shared TypeScript domain types
tasks.description: Define types for User, Document, DocumentMember, DocumentRole, Comment, Version, Presence, AI operations, and the ApiResponse envelope - generated from swagger where practical.
acceptanceCriteria: Types mirror the server DTOs exactly, including enum values
ApiResponse<T> models the { success, message, code } contract
No use of any in service signatures

tasks.title: Routing and application shell layout
tasks.description: React Router setup with public routes (login, register, invitation landing), protected routes (dashboard, document, profile), a shared app layout with header/nav, and lazy-loaded route chunks.
acceptanceCriteria: Deep-linking to /documents/{id} works after a full page reload
Unknown routes render a 404 page
Editor route is code-split from the dashboard

tasks.title: HTTP API client with interceptors
tasks.description: services/api.ts wrapping the HTTP client with base URL config, bearer token injection, ApiResponse unwrapping, typed error normalization and an abort-signal-aware request helper.
acceptanceCriteria: Callers receive typed data or a typed ApiError carrying message and code
Base URL comes from environment configuration
In-flight requests can be cancelled on unmount

tasks.title: Environment configuration
tasks.description: Typed access to Vite env vars for API base URL, hub URL and feature flags, with a validation step that fails the build on missing required values.
acceptanceCriteria: Missing required env var produces a clear startup error, not undefined at runtime
Feature flags allow AI and RAG UI to be toggled off

tasks.title: Testing harness (Vitest + React Testing Library)
tasks.description: Configure Vitest with jsdom, RTL, MSW for API mocking, and shared test utilities for rendering with router/store providers.
acceptanceCriteria: A sample component test passes via npm test
API calls in tests are intercepted by MSW, never hitting the network
Coverage reporting is configured

tasks.title: Error boundaries, toasts and global feedback
tasks.description: Route-level error boundaries, a toast system fed by the API error normalizer, and shared loading/empty/error state components.
acceptanceCriteria: A thrown render error shows a recoverable fallback, not a blank page
Server error codes map to friendly, human messages
One consistent empty/loading/error pattern is used across pages

tasks.title: Auth store (Zustand)
tasks.description: store/auth.store.ts holding user, access token, auth status and actions; access token in memory, refresh token in a persisted secure store, with rehydration on app boot.
acceptanceCriteria: Refreshing the page keeps the user signed in
Access token is not written to localStorage
Auth state exposes a loading phase so guards do not flash the login page

tasks.title: Auth service
tasks.description: services/auth.service.ts covering register, login, refresh, logout, getProfile, updateProfile and changePassword against the auth endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: Every method is fully typed with no any
Service is unit tested against MSW handlers

tasks.title: Silent token refresh and 401 retry interceptor
tasks.description: Interceptor that refreshes an expired access token once, queues concurrent 401s behind a single refresh call, retries them, and forces logout when refresh fails.
acceptanceCriteria: Five simultaneous 401s trigger exactly one refresh request
Failed refresh clears auth state and redirects to login without a loop
SignalR connection picks up the new token after refresh

tasks.title: Register page
tasks.description: Registration form with client-side validation matching server rules, field-level server error mapping, password strength hint and post-register redirect.
acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate email shows an inline field error, not a raw toast
Submit is disabled while pending and cannot double-submit
Successful registration lands on the dashboard authenticated

tasks.title: Login page
tasks.description: Login form with validation, generic credential error handling, and return-url support so protected deep links resume after sign-in.
acceptanceCriteria: Being redirected from /documents/{id} returns there after login
Invalid credentials show a single generic message

tasks.title: Route guards and role-aware access
tasks.description: ProtectedRoute and PublicOnlyRoute wrappers plus a permission helper for role gating in UI, with the explicit rule that UI gating is convenience only and the server is authoritative.
acceptanceCriteria: No protected content renders before auth rehydration completes
Logged-in users visiting /login are redirected to the dashboard
Permission helper mirrors the server role matrix from PRD section 27

tasks.title: Logout and session expiry handling
tasks.description: Logout action clearing auth state, closing the SignalR connection, flushing pending local writes and revoking the refresh token server-side.
acceptanceCriteria: Logout leaves no user data or tokens in storage
Any open hub connection is disposed
Unsaved buffered edits are flushed before the session closes

tasks.title: Profile and change password page
tasks.description: View and edit display name and avatar, plus a change-password form that signs other sessions out.
acceptanceCriteria: Display name change is reflected immediately in presence and comments
Wrong current password shows an inline error

tasks.title: User avatar and identity color utilities
tasks.description: Deterministic per-user color derivation and an avatar component with image, initials fallback and online indicator - shared by presence, cursors and comments.
acceptanceCriteria: The same user gets the same color in every browser and session
Colors have sufficient contrast against both editor themes

tasks.title: Authentication UI tests
tasks.description: RTL tests for login/register validation and submission, guard redirects, and the refresh/queue/logout interceptor behaviour.
acceptanceCriteria: Concurrent-401 single-refresh behaviour is asserted
Guard redirect with return-url is asserted

tasks.title: Document service
tasks.description: services/document.service.ts covering list (with search/sort/scope/paging), get, create, update, delete, archive, restore, duplicate and getState.
acceptanceCriteria: All query parameters are typed and serialized correctly
Service is covered by MSW-backed unit tests

tasks.title: Document store and data caching
tasks.description: store/document.store.ts for the active document and list state, with a query-cache strategy for list refetching, optimistic updates and rollback on failure.
acceptanceCriteria: Rename updates the list instantly and rolls back on server rejection
Navigating back to the dashboard does not refetch unnecessarily

tasks.title: Dashboard layout and document list
tasks.description: Dashboard matching the PRD section 8 layout: header with New button, search bar, and a list showing title, relative last-edited time, owner/shared badge and collaborator avatars.
acceptanceCriteria: Relative timestamps render as 'Edited 2 min ago' style text
Rows are keyboard navigable and open on Enter
Skeleton loading state renders before data arrives

tasks.title: Create document flow
tasks.description: New button creates an 'Untitled Document' and navigates straight into the editor with the title field focused for immediate renaming.
acceptanceCriteria: Document is created and opened in under one interaction
Failure shows an error toast and leaves the user on the dashboard

tasks.title: Search, sort, filter and scope tabs
tasks.description: Debounced search input, sort control (recently edited, name, created), and scope tabs for All, Owned by me, Shared with me, Recent and Archived, with state reflected in the URL.
acceptanceCriteria: Search is debounced and cancels superseded requests
Filter state survives a page reload via the URL
Empty results show a scope-specific empty state

tasks.title: Document row actions (rename, duplicate, archive, delete, restore)
tasks.description: Context menu per document with inline rename, duplicate, archive, delete with confirmation, and restore for archived items - actions hidden or disabled based on the caller's role.
acceptanceCriteria: Delete requires explicit confirmation naming the document
Non-owners do not see destructive actions
Duplicate opens or highlights the new copy

tasks.title: Dashboard empty, loading and error states
tasks.description: First-run empty state with a create call-to-action, skeleton list while loading, and a retryable error state.
acceptanceCriteria: A brand new account sees a helpful empty state, not a blank list
Network failure offers a retry that refetches

tasks.title: Dashboard tests
tasks.description: RTL tests for list rendering, search debounce, scope filtering, row actions and role-based action visibility.
acceptanceCriteria: Optimistic rename rollback on failure is asserted
Viewer role sees no delete action

tasks.title: Tiptap editor integration
tasks.description: Mount a Tiptap editor with StarterKit, editable/read-only modes, focus management and a stable extension registry that collaboration will later extend.
acceptanceCriteria: Editor mounts once per document and disposes cleanly on unmount
Read-only mode disables all input without unmounting the editor
Extension list is defined in one place for reuse by collaboration and comments

tasks.title: Full formatting extension set
tasks.description: Enable bold, italic, underline, strike, headings, paragraphs, bullet/ordered lists, task lists, links, code blocks with highlighting, blockquotes, tables, images and horizontal rules, with keyboard shortcuts and input rules.
acceptanceCriteria: Every formatting item in PRD section 10 is available and functional
Markdown-style input rules work (## heading, - list, ``` code)
Pasting rich content preserves supported formatting and strips the rest

tasks.title: Toolbar and bubble/floating menus
tasks.description: Sticky top toolbar with grouped controls and active-state indicators, a selection bubble menu, and a slash/floating menu on empty lines - with a reserved slot for the AI entry point.
acceptanceCriteria: Toolbar buttons reflect the active mark/node at the cursor
Toolbar is fully keyboard accessible with visible focus
Controls are disabled in read-only mode

tasks.title: Tables, images and code block UX
tasks.description: Table insert/resize/row-column controls, image insert with sizing, and code blocks with language selection and syntax highlighting.
acceptanceCriteria: Tables can be created, resized and have rows/columns added or removed
Code block language choice persists in the document
These node types survive a save/reload round trip

tasks.title: Document page shell and title editing
tasks.description: Editor page with header (back navigation, inline title editing, save state, presence slot, Share slot, AI slot, overflow menu) and a centered document canvas.
acceptanceCriteria: Title edits save on blur or Enter and are debounced
Header slots exist for presence, share, AI and history before those features land
Layout holds at narrow widths without breaking the canvas

tasks.title: Autosave state machine and save indicator
tasks.description: Track editing/saving/saved/error/offline states driven by local change events and server acknowledgements, surfaced as an 'All changes saved' style indicator.
acceptanceCriteria: Indicator never claims saved while updates are still unacknowledged
Unload with unsaved buffered changes warns the user
Offline is visually distinct from error

tasks.title: Local undo/redo
tasks.description: History with keyboard shortcuts and toolbar buttons, structured so it can be swapped for the Yjs UndoManager when collaboration lands.
acceptanceCriteria: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z work across all formatting operations
Buttons disable correctly when there is nothing to undo or redo

tasks.title: Editor performance guards
tasks.description: Prevent editor re-render storms: memoized toolbar, throttled selection-derived state, and avoidance of React state updates per keystroke.
acceptanceCriteria: Typing in a large document keeps input latency imperceptible
Profiler shows no full-page re-render per keystroke

tasks.title: Editor tests
tasks.description: Tests for formatting commands, toolbar active states, read-only enforcement, title editing and the save state machine.
acceptanceCriteria: Every formatting command has at least one assertion
Read-only mode is asserted to block all edits

tasks.title: Yjs document and ProseMirror binding
tasks.description: Create a Y.Doc per document, bind it to Tiptap via the Collaboration extension, replace the local history extension with the Yjs UndoManager, and manage lifecycle so switching documents never leaks a doc.
acceptanceCriteria: Editing mutates the Y.Doc and the editor stays in sync
Navigating between documents destroys the previous Y.Doc and its observers
Client never implements CRDT logic itself - Yjs owns conflict resolution

tasks.title: Custom SignalR Yjs provider
tasks.description: A provider that connects the Y.Doc to the SignalR hub: sends local updates via SendDocumentUpdate, applies remote DocumentChanged updates with a non-local origin, performs the initial state handshake and the reconnect sync, and relays awareness.
acceptanceCriteria: Two browsers converge on identical content when editing simultaneously
Remote updates are applied with a foreign origin so they are excluded from local undo
Provider survives reconnect without duplicating or dropping updates
Update payloads are transferred as binary, not base64-inflated JSON, where the transport allows

tasks.title: Collaboration service (hub connection lifecycle)
tasks.description: services/collaboration.service.ts building the HubConnection with the access-token factory, automatic reconnect policy, typed event registration and connect/disconnect per document.
acceptanceCriteria: Hub methods and events are strongly typed in one contract file
Token refresh supplies a fresh token to the connection factory
Only one connection exists per open document, with handlers cleaned up on close

tasks.title: Collaboration store
tasks.description: store/collaboration.store.ts holding connection status, active users, remote cursors, the caller's effective role and lock state, kept out of the per-keystroke hot path.
acceptanceCriteria: Presence updates do not re-render the editor content area
Store resets fully when leaving a document

tasks.title: useCollaboration hook
tasks.description: Single hook that wires Y.Doc, provider, hub connection and store together for a document id, returning ready state, connection status and role - the one entry point the editor page uses.
acceptanceCriteria: Editor renders only after the initial state sync completes
Unmount tears down provider, connection and doc with no leaks
React StrictMode double-mount does not create duplicate connections

tasks.title: Awareness setup (local user state)
tasks.description: Publish local awareness (user id, name, color, cursor, selection, activity) with throttling, and consume remote awareness changes into the collaboration store.
acceptanceCriteria: Cursor broadcasts are throttled to a sane rate under fast typing
Awareness state clears when the user disconnects
Awareness is never persisted locally or server-side

tasks.title: Remote cursors and selection highlights
tasks.description: CollaborationCursor rendering with per-user color, name label on hover/idle, and selection range highlighting that stays anchored as the document changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Remote cursor position stays correct while local text is inserted before it
Labels do not obscure text while typing
Colors match the presence bar for the same user

tasks.title: Presence avatar bar
tasks.description: Header component listing active users with avatar, name, online dot and activity (Editing/Viewing), overflow +N popover, and click-to-jump-to-cursor.
acceptanceCriteria: Matches the PRD section 14 information set
A user with two tabs appears once
Joining and leaving update the bar within a second

tasks.title: Connection status indicator
tasks.description: Visible connected/reconnecting/offline indicator with reconnect attempt feedback and a manual retry action.
acceptanceCriteria: Killing the network switches to Offline within a few seconds
Recovery returns to Connected automatically without a page reload

tasks.title: Collaborative undo/redo
tasks.description: Configure the Yjs UndoManager to track only local origins (including accepted AI transactions) so undo never reverts another collaborator's work.
acceptanceCriteria: User A pressing undo never removes user B's text
Undo after accepting an AI suggestion removes the AI insertion in one step
Redo restores exactly what undo removed

tasks.title: Collaboration tests
tasks.description: Tests using two in-memory Y.Docs with a fake transport to assert convergence, awareness propagation, origin-scoped undo and provider teardown.
acceptanceCriteria: Concurrent edits to the same paragraph converge in tests (PRD section 45 Test 1)
Undo scope test proves remote changes are untouched
No test requires a running backend

tasks.title: Local persistence with IndexedDB
tasks.description: Attach y-indexeddb to each document's Y.Doc so content is available instantly on reload and survives a closed tab while offline, with a per-user storage namespace.
acceptanceCriteria: Reloading offline restores the document with local edits intact
Logging out clears cached document data for that user
Local load happens before or alongside the network sync without flicker

tasks.title: Connection loss detection
tasks.description: Combine browser online/offline events with hub connection state and a heartbeat so a silently dead connection is still detected.
acceptanceCriteria: A dropped WebSocket with the network still 'online' is detected
State transitions are debounced so brief blips do not flap the UI

tasks.title: Offline update queue
tasks.description: While disconnected, keep editing locally and let Yjs accumulate state; on reconnect send the diff computed from the server's state vector rather than replaying every individual update.
acceptanceCriteria: Ten minutes of offline editing syncs in a single diff exchange
No local edit is lost across the offline window
Queue is bounded and cannot exhaust memory in a long session

tasks.title: Automatic reconnection and resync
tasks.description: Exponential backoff reconnect with jitter, automatic rejoin of the document group, state-vector resync, and awareness re-publication.
acceptanceCriteria: Reconnect after a server restart succeeds without user action
Post-reconnect content matches every other connected client
Presence reappears for the reconnected user

tasks.title: Offline UI affordances
tasks.description: Offline banner explaining that editing continues locally, pending-change count, syncing state on reconnect, and a completion confirmation.
acceptanceCriteria: The user is never told 'saved' while offline changes are unsynced
Sync completion is explicitly confirmed
Banner does not obstruct the editing area

tasks.title: Offline and reconnection tests
tasks.description: Simulate disconnect, offline divergence between two clients, and reconnect merge; assert final convergence and preserved edits (PRD section 45 Tests 3, 4 and 5).
acceptanceCriteria: Two clients editing the same text while disconnected converge on reconnect
Mid-edit disconnect loses nothing
Reconnect with pending changes broadcasts them to peers

tasks.title: Comment anchoring in the editor
tasks.description: Custom comment mark backed by Yjs relative positions so highlights stay attached to the right text as the document changes, including when edited by others.
acceptanceCriteria: A comment stays on its text after another user inserts a paragraph above it
Deleting the commented text marks the comment orphaned rather than crashing
Anchors survive a reload

tasks.title: Comment service and store
tasks.description: comment.service.ts and a comment store covering list, create, update, delete, reply, resolve and reopen with optimistic updates.
acceptanceCriteria: Optimistic comment appears instantly and rolls back on failure
Store keys comments by anchor for fast editor lookup

tasks.title: Comment sidebar and thread UI
tasks.description: Right sidebar listing threads with quoted text, author avatar, timestamp and replies; clicking a thread scrolls to and highlights its anchor and vice versa.
acceptanceCriteria: Selecting a highlight in the document focuses its thread
Threads are ordered by document position, not creation time
Sidebar collapses without disturbing the editor layout

tasks.title: Create comment from selection
tasks.description: Comment action in the bubble menu opening a composer prefilled with the quoted selection, applying the mark on submit.
acceptanceCriteria: Comment action is hidden for Viewer role
Cancelling the composer leaves no orphan mark
Escape closes the composer and restores selection

tasks.title: Replies, edit and delete
tasks.description: Inline reply box per thread, edit-in-place for own comments, and delete with confirmation, with actions gated by authorship and role.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can only edit or delete their own comments unless they own the document
Deleting a parent removes its replies from the UI immediately

tasks.title: Resolve, reopen and thread filtering
tasks.description: Resolve button that collapses the thread and removes its highlight, a Show resolved toggle, and reopen support.
acceptanceCriteria: Resolved threads are hidden by default and their highlights removed
Reopening restores the highlight at the original anchor

tasks.title: @mention autocomplete
tasks.description: Typing @ in a comment opens a keyboard-navigable member picker scoped to document members, inserting a mention token rendered as a chip.
acceptanceCriteria: Only document members are suggested
Arrow keys and Enter select without leaving the composer
Mentions render distinctly in the saved comment

tasks.title: Real-time comment synchronization
tasks.description: Subscribe to CommentAdded/Updated/Deleted/Resolved hub events and reconcile them into the comment store without clobbering local optimistic state.
acceptanceCriteria: A comment added by another user appears without a refresh
A remote event for a locally pending comment does not duplicate it

tasks.title: Comment tests
tasks.description: Tests for anchor stability under concurrent edits, thread CRUD, resolve filtering, mention picker and role gating.
acceptanceCriteria: Anchor-drift test inserts text before a comment and asserts it stays attached
Viewer cannot open the comment composer

tasks.title: Share dialog
tasks.description: Share dialog matching PRD section 24: email input, role selector, Send Invitation action, current member list and share-link section.
acceptanceCriteria: Share button is only enabled for the Owner
Email validation happens before submit
Dialog is fully keyboard operable and traps focus

tasks.title: Member list management
tasks.description: List members with avatar, email and role dropdown; allow role changes and removal, with the owner row protected and pending invitations shown separately.
acceptanceCriteria: Owner row cannot be demoted or removed in the UI
Role change reflects immediately with rollback on failure
Pending invitations are visually distinct from accepted members

tasks.title: Invitation landing page
tasks.description: Public /invite/{token} route showing the document title, inviter and granted role, routing unauthenticated users through login/register and returning them to accept.
acceptanceCriteria: A brand new user can register from the link and land inside the document
Expired or already-used tokens show a clear, non-technical message
Accepting navigates straight into the document

tasks.title: Share link UI
tasks.description: Enable/disable a link, choose Viewer or Editor access, copy to clipboard with confirmation, and regenerate the token.
acceptanceCriteria: Disabling the link is reflected instantly and the URL stops working
Copy action gives explicit feedback
The UI states plainly what access the link grants

tasks.title: Permission-aware editor UI
tasks.description: Drive editor capability from the server-provided effective role: Viewer gets read-only with no toolbar, Commenter gets read-only plus commenting, Editor and Owner get full editing plus AI.
deliverables: Role-driven capability layer in the editor page
acceptanceCriteria: Viewer cannot type, paste or drop content into the document
Commenter can create comments but not edit content
A read-only badge explains the current access level

tasks.title: Live permission change handling
tasks.description: React to PermissionChanged and removal events mid-session: downgrade to read-only in place, or eject to the dashboard with an explanation, flushing pending edits first.
acceptanceCriteria: Demotion to Viewer while typing stops editing without losing already-synced work
Access revocation redirects with a clear message, not a raw error
Covers PRD section 45 Test 8 from the client side

tasks.title: Sharing and permissions tests
tasks.description: Tests for the share dialog, member role changes, invitation landing states and role-driven editor capability.
acceptanceCriteria: Each of the four roles has an editor-capability assertion
Expired invitation state is asserted

tasks.title: Version service and history panel
tasks.description: version.service.ts plus a revision history panel grouped by Today/Yesterday/date showing author, change type and time, matching the PRD section 19 tree layout.
acceptanceCriteria: AI-generated versions are visually labelled as such
Grouping headers match the PRD example
Long histories load incrementally

tasks.title: Version preview
tasks.description: Selecting a version renders its content read-only in the main canvas with a banner indicating a historical view and a way back to the live document.
acceptanceCriteria: Preview cannot be edited and does not emit Yjs updates
Returning to live restores the collaborative session without a reload
The banner makes it unmistakable that this is history

tasks.title: Restore version flow
tasks.description: Restore action with a confirmation explaining that all collaborators will see the restored content, followed by handling the DocumentRestored broadcast for everyone in the room.
acceptanceCriteria: All connected clients converge on the restored content without a reload
Restore is undoable via normal undo
Non-editors do not see the restore action

tasks.title: Version comparison view
tasks.description: Side-by-side or inline diff highlighting additions and deletions between two selected versions.
acceptanceCriteria: Additions and deletions are distinguishable without relying on color alone
Large diffs remain scrollable and performant

tasks.title: Versioning tests
tasks.description: Tests for history grouping, preview read-only enforcement and the restore confirmation flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Preview mode is asserted to reject edits
Restore requires confirmation before firing the request

tasks.title: Soft lock indicators
tasks.description: Informational markers showing which section another user is currently editing, derived from awareness, without blocking input.
acceptanceCriteria: Hint reads like the PRD example and disappears when the user moves away
Hints never block typing

tasks.title: Hard lock banner and editor disable
tasks.description: On DocumentLocked, show who holds the lock and until when, and switch non-holders to read-only; restore editing on DocumentUnlocked.
acceptanceCriteria: Locking mid-session disables editing for others within a second
The lock holder keeps editing uninterrupted
Unlock restores editing without a reload

tasks.title: Lock controls for owner
tasks.description: Owner menu items to lock and unlock the document, with expiry display and renewal.
deliverables: Lock controls in the document overflow menu
acceptanceCriteria: Only the owner sees lock controls
Remaining lock time is visible to the holder

tasks.title: AI service and useAI hook
tasks.description: ai.service.ts covering all Phase 1 operations plus a useAI hook managing request state, cancellation and error mapping.
acceptanceCriteria: Every operation is typed with a shared request/response shape
An in-flight request can be cancelled and aborts the network call
AI_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE and AI_QUOTA_EXCEEDED map to distinct user messages

tasks.title: AI toolbar menu
tasks.description: Sparkle AI button opening the PRD section 30 menu (Generate, Rewrite, Improve, Summarize, Expand, Shorten, Fix Grammar, Change Tone, Continue), with a tone submenu and selection-aware enabling.
acceptanceCriteria: Selection-dependent operations are disabled with no selection
The menu is hidden entirely for Viewer and Commenter roles
Keyboard navigation works throughout the menu

tasks.title: AI selection popover
tasks.description: Selecting text surfaces a quick AI action popover in the bubble menu with the most common operations and a free-form instruction field.
acceptanceCriteria: Popover does not obstruct the selected text
Escape dismisses it and restores the selection intact

tasks.title: AI result preview with Accept / Reject / Regenerate
tasks.description: Preview panel showing original versus generated text with Accept, Reject and Regenerate actions, matching the PRD section 31 workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Nothing is written into the document until Accept is pressed
Reject leaves the document byte-identical
Regenerate reuses the same selection and operation

tasks.title: Accept AI output as a Yjs transaction
tasks.description: Apply accepted AI content through a single tagged Yjs transaction so it flows to collaborators via SignalR and is undoable in one step, correctly resolving the target range even if the document shifted during generation.
acceptanceCriteria: Other collaborators see the AI insertion in real time
A single undo removes the entire AI insertion
If the anchored range was edited during generation, the user is warned instead of overwriting the wrong text
Covers PRD section 45 Test 6 from the client side

tasks.title: Streaming AI output rendering
tasks.description: Render tokens progressively in the preview panel as they stream, with a stop button that cancels generation.
acceptanceCriteria: Text appears progressively rather than after a long blank wait
Stop cancels the server call, not just the UI
A stopped partial result can still be accepted or rejected

tasks.title: AI loading, error and quota states
tasks.description: Skeleton/spinner during generation, retryable error state, offline guard, and clear messaging for quota and service-unavailable errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Ollama being down shows a human message, not a raw 503
AI actions are disabled while offline
The editor stays fully usable during generation

tasks.title: AI Phase 2 document-aware UI
tasks.description: Ask-about-document chat panel, whole-document summary, outline generation, action items and meeting notes, with insert-into-document actions and source references when RAG is enabled.
acceptanceCriteria: Answers show which parts of the document they came from when RAG is on
Generated outlines and action items insert as proper document nodes
The panel is behind a feature flag so it can ship dark

tasks.title: AI UI tests
tasks.description: Tests for the AI menu gating, preview accept/reject/regenerate flow, single-transaction insertion, undo behaviour and error states, with the AI service mocked.
acceptanceCriteria: Reject is asserted to leave the document unchanged
Accept-then-undo is asserted to remove the insertion in one step
Viewer role sees no AI entry points

tasks.title: Notification center
